sample_unit: guideline-based clinical questions (LLM responses rated by 11 experts)

links.outcome: Expert Delphi agreement with LLM answers to guideline-derived prostate cancer questions
links.effect: Consensus agreement reached for 23/25 (92%) Gemini, 20/25 (80%) ChatGPT, 14/25 (56%) Claude (p = 0.0033); Claude had explicit disagreement on 3 questions (12%).
links.quote: After two Delphi rounds, consensus in agreement was reached for 23/25 responses (92%) with Gemini, 20/25 (80%) with ChatGPT and 14/25 (56%) with Claude (p = 0.0033).

links.outcome: LLM output accuracy against expert panel judgment on guideline-derived questions
links.effect: Median scores of at least 7 of 9 in 24/25 (96%) Gemini, 22/25 (88%) ChatGPT, and 14/25 (56%) Claude responses (p = 0.0002).
links.quote: Median scores of at least 7 out of 9, indicating strong agreement, were achieved in 24/25 responses (96%) for Gemini, 22/25 (88%) for ChatGPT, and 14/25 (56%) for Claude (p = 0.0002).

unlisted_practices: Providing plain-language adaptations of guideline figures and tables to LLMs to improve guideline interpretation

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the performance and clinical alignment of multiple LLMs (Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude) against clinical guidelines using a multidisciplinary Delphi panel, but does not test a specific deployment guardrail or practice intervention.
